summary: This bill amends the Balanced Budget and Emergency Deficit Control Act of 1985 to establish specific discretionary spending limits for fiscal years 2026 through 2029.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly sets discretionary spending limits for fiscal years 2026 through 2029, aiming to cap and potentially reduce future government expenditures. This is the primary purpose of the bill.

By setting discretionary spending limits, the bill aims to control government outlays, which would contribute to reducing future deficits and, consequently, the national debt. This is a central goal of the legislation.
